_doc: Kingdom Defense child safety (COPPA / Google Play Families, mixed audience). Every open Derek decision is a value here; defaults are the safe choice. Read by Survival.Domain.Kids.ChildSafetyConfig. Not legal advice: counsel reviews before ship.
_age_bands_doc: DEREK DECISION: age bands. Ordered by max_age (inclusive); the last band has no max_age. child=true bands get the 'child' rules. e.g. 6-8 / 9-12 / 13+ = [{id:'6to8',max_age:8,child:true},{id:'9to12',max_age:12,child:true},{id:'13plus',child:false}].
_child_doc: Rules for child bands and for anyone whose age is not known yet. Floors the code enforces whatever this says: advertising_id false, personalization false, chat never 'free'. DEREK DECISIONS: chat (off|presets), iap (parental_gate|blocked|allowed), iap_max_per_day (null = no cap), analytics/crash_reporting (off|limited) once a vendor is picked.
_ads_doc: No ads in soft launch (recommended). If ads ever ship: enabled=true AND each SDK+version copied from Google's Families Self-Certified Ads SDK list (source_url) with verified_on set to the date checked. AdsSdkGuard refuses anything else, for every player.
_telemetry_doc: DEREK DECISION: analytics / crash vendor. 'none' = nothing is sent for anyone (no-op sink). Note: Google's Self-Certified program is for ADS SDKs only; an analytics vendor needs its own child-directed ToS + config review.
_chat_presets_doc: Preset phrases for chat 'presets' mode. Sent as the id only (server stores [[p:<id>]]), so no free text, links or personal info can travel. Localize via strings key kids.chat.preset.<id>.
_account_doc: DEREK SUPPLIES: hosted web deletion page (Play Console Data safety 'delete account URL') and the support contact. Placeholders until then.
_legal_doc: DEREK SUPPLIES: hosted privacy policy and terms of service URLs (Play listing + Settings links). Placeholders until then.
